liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Here Comes Sunshine** (3 reviews): Reviewer called the Sunshine into Stranger opener sick and says Speedway also rocked; Reviewer disliked the cheap-sounding keyboard tone Vince used at the start [11][13][15]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Scarlet into Fire On The Mountain was sweet; Reviewer found great jams in Scarlet into Fire [5][15]
- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Jerry used a sweet effect the reviewer's circle called the 'Alien Tone'; Jerry repeatedly teased Comes a Time at the end of the Dark Star; reviewer's favorite moment [8][12]
- **Space** (2 reviews): Jerry uses a very out-there MIDI sound during Space; The Drums to Space segue contains strange chanting that the reviewer found freaky [9][12]
- **New Speedway Boogie** (1 review): Reviewer was surprised to hear it in the first set [5]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry mostly strummed basic chords for about ten minutes, with brief soloing before the reprise [14]
- **Liberty** (1 review): Reviewer disliked closing the show with Liberty, calling the encore weak [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-03-30.110956.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 179 min; rated 3.33/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd94-03-30.sbd.miller.14832.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 174 min; rated 3.85/5 by 47 [2]. Said about its sound: Well played overall, with a little static during the drums; Recording quality of the bootleg is great, but the reviewer heard many flubs; Reviewer thinks it is an FM broadcast or DAT, not a true soundboard: crisp, with no crowd noise [12][14][15]
- **gd1994-03-30.sbd.larson.3621.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 168 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [3]
- **gd1994-03-30.sbd.larson.31806.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 168 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer had two spare tickets and gave them to two people outside, since tickets weren't scarce [6]
- A very loud crowd roar signaled the band had come onstage [6]
- Reviewer attended with his son, now 13, who brags about seeing the last Dark Star [8]
- Reviewer calls it a high point of 1994, though the band was past its peak [5]
- Reviewer saw about a dozen 1994 shows and ranks this the best [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-03-30.110956.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alan Schmit; transferred by Terry Watts; source: Source: (ORTF/110^/DFC/FOB/16th Row) B&K 4011s > Neumann BS48i-2 > TCD-D3 > DAT(m); [1]
- **gd94-03-30.sbd.miller.14832.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Recording Info:SBD -> Dat Transfer Info:Dat (Sony R500) ->Prodif Plus ->Samplitude v6.0 ->SHN [2]. Also: Matches an old Italian bootleg, which had a poor audience-source Liberty pasted in; this version is better and complete; The bootleg's back-cover setlist misprinted Sugar Magnolia as 'Booger Magnolia' [10][14]
- **gd1994-03-30.sbd.larson.3621.shnf**: taped by Thanks to Chris Larson for the discs; transferred by EAC and SHN Conversion by Tony Gardner; source: SBD: DAT> ZA2> Samplitude2496> CDR> EAC> SHN [3]
- **gd1994-03-30.sbd.larson.31806.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Chris Larson; source: S:D>ZA2>Samplitude2496>CD-R [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-04-01 The Omni, Atlanta, GA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-04-01-the-omni-atlanta-ga-usa/) [18]
